name: Katori (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Katori city emblem in blue, light blue and green: stylised curved strokes in blue, light blue and green, like leaves and water.
history: Municipal flag of Katori, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 September 2006.
